name: navbar-transparent
title: Transparent navbar
description: A navbar that sits over the hero with no background and turns solid with a hairline as soon as the page scrolls.
docs: The bar is fixed to the top of the window and see-through at rest, so put it over a hero that is already dark (tone="light", the default) or light (tone="dark"). Once the page has scrolled past threshold (24px) it takes the page colour and a hairline. One passive scroll listener sets data-scrolled on the header for your own styling, and the state starts from the real scroll position. At rest with a light tone the text is white and the bar speaks the dark theme's tokens, so buttons you pass as actions are legible on a photograph; a theme with no dark tokens should give those buttons colours of their own. Once solid the bar hands everything back to the page. The phone menu opens on a solid sheet; navLabel names the navigation landmark, and menuLabel the menu button and the title of the sheet. In a layout that scrolls inside a container, the bar follows that container instead of the window: pass className="sticky -mb-16" so the hero still slides under it. Pass scrolled to fix the state for a preview or a test.
